basic_details.job_title: Sainik School Rewari Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 5 Nursing Assistant, PGT & Other Posts
basic_details.total_vacancies: Medical Officer, PEM/PTI cum Matron, Nursing Assistant, Counsellor, PGT (Physical Education)

age_limit.details: The age limit for Medical Officer, PEM/PTI cum Matron, and Nursing Assistant is 18 to 50 years, and for Counsellor and PGT (Physical Education) is 21 to 50 years, calculated as on 17 October 2026. how_to_apply: Download the prescribed application form from the official school website at www.ssrw.org.
Fill out the application form carefully and attach attested copies of mark sheets, degree certificates, and experience certificates indicating the percentage of marks from Matriculation onwards.
Enclose one recent passport-size photograph along with mobile number and valid e-mail ID.
Attach a crossed Bank Draft of Rs. 500/- (non-refundable) drawn in favour of ‘Principal, Sainik School Rewari’, payable at Rewari (SC and ST categories are exempted from the application fee).
Enclose a self-addressed envelope duly affixed with postage stamps of Rs. 56/- for the dispatch of the Admit Card.
Ensure the post applied for is clearly superscribed on the envelope.

Send the completed application form by India Post or submit it by hand to: Principal, Sainik School Rewari, Village – Gothra Ahir, Distt- Rewari, Haryana - 123102, to reach by 06 November 2026 up to 1700 Hrs.
important_instructions: Applications must be sent strictly through India Post or submitted by hand; private courier services are not accepted. Applications received after the due date, without the application fee, or not submitted in the prescribed format will be rejected. No TA/DA will be admissible for attending the selection process. Contract period can be curtailed by the school due to administrative or policy reasons without compensation liability. Upon completing the maximum 3-year engagement, contractual employees have no claim or right for regular appointment and must execute an undertaking/bond to this effect.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The consolidated monthly remuneration for each post is fixed as follows: Rs. 84,960/- for Medical Officer, Rs. 46,720/- for PEM/PTI cum Matron, Rs. 40,800/- for Nursing Assistant, Rs. 71,840/- for Counsellor, and Rs. 76,160/- for PGT (Physical Education). The contractual appointment is made for an initial period of 11 months from the date of joining plus a one-month break period, extendable annually up to a maximum period of three years only, subject to satisfactory performance and institutional requirements. Formal performance evaluations are conducted quarterly by the Vice Principal or Administrative Officer and reviewed by the Principal. No remuneration is payable during the prescribed break period or during school vacations/breaks when the contractual employee is not on active duty.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit and Relaxations
content_sections.text: The age limit for Medical Officer, PEM/PTI cum Matron, and Nursing Assistant is 18 to 50 years, and for Counsellor and PGT (Physical Education) is 21 to 50 years, calculated as on 17 October 2026. The maximum age limit is increased by 5 years for candidates belonging to Scheduled Castes (SC) and Scheduled Tribes (ST), and by 3 years for candidates belonging to Other Backward Classes (OBC).

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Sainik School Rewari Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the prescribed application form from the official school website at www.ssrw.org. Fill out the application form carefully and attach attested copies of mark sheets, degree certificates, and experience certificates indicating the percentage of marks from Matriculation onwards. Enclose one recent passport-size photograph along with mobile number and valid e-mail ID. Attach a crossed Bank Draft of Rs. 500/- (non-refundable) drawn in favour of ‘Principal, Sainik School Rewari’, payable at Rewari (SC and ST categories are exempted from the application fee). Enclose a self-addressed envelope duly affixed with postage stamps of Rs. 56/- for the dispatch of the Admit Card. Ensure the post applied for is clearly superscribed on the envelope. Send the completed application form by India Post or submit it by hand to: Principal, Sainik School Rewari, Village – Gothra Ahir, Distt- Rewari, Haryana - 123102, to reach by 06 November 2026 up to 1700 Hrs.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Attested copies of mark sheets and degree certificates from Matriculation onwards Experience certificates indicating percentage of marks and duration Recent passport-size photograph Crossed Bank Draft of Rs. 500/- (exempted for SC/ST) Self-addressed envelope affixed with postage stamps of Rs. 56/-

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications must be sent strictly through India Post or submitted by hand; private courier services are not accepted. Applications received after the due date, without the application fee, or not submitted in the prescribed format will be rejected. No TA/DA will be admissible for attending the selection process. Contract period can be curtailed by the school due to administrative or policy reasons without compensation liability. Upon completing the maximum 3-year engagement, contractual employees have no claim or right for regular appointment and must execute an undertaking/bond to this effect.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Sainik School Rewari Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications is 06 November 2026 up to 1700 Hrs.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are advertised?
faq.answer: A total of 5 vacancies are advertised across various contractual posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for general candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 500/- in the form of a crossed Bank Draft drawn in favour of ‘Principal, Sainik School Rewari’, payable at Rewari. SC and ST candidates are exempted.

faq.question: Q4. Are these positions permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: These positions are purely on a contractual basis for an initial period of one year (11 months service plus 1 month break), extendable up to a maximum of three years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 50 years as on 17 October 2026, with age relaxations applicable for SC, ST, and OBC candidates.

faq.question: Q6. How can candidates submit their application forms?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent through India Post or submitted by hand to the Principal, Sainik School Rewari.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for the PGT (Physical Education) post?
faq.answer: The consolidated salary for PGT (Physical Education) is Rs. 76,160/- per month.

faq.question: Q8. Who is exempted from paying the application fee?
faq.answer: Candidates belonging to Scheduled Caste (SC) and Scheduled Tribe (ST) categories are exempted from paying the application fee.
